text:
jamal: Heads up — since ~04:20 UTC ap-southeast1-b has a spike in GPU pod preempts (12% of GPU jobs in last 20m). Nodes show conntrack saturation + short NotReady flaps. Noticed evictions clustered to a few racks.
mira: ugh. any k8s evict reason payloads?
jamal: logs: ```kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
kubelet: eviction manager: eviction threshold reached, reclaiming resources
iptables: conntrack table 65536/65536```
alex: can you link grafana panel?
jamal: https://grafana.internal/r/conntrack/ap-southeast1-b — conntrack_count jumps to ~65k then pods get evicted. Also S3 multipart workloads around same time.
mira: tried bumping nf_conntrack_max on a single canary node and requeued a job. immediate drop in evicts on that node. tested with: ```sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144```
ops-bot: action: deploy/sysctl-bump-canary by mira at 04:45 UTC :white_check_mark:
jamal: canary healed, but other racks still failing — seems rollout needed plus root cause mitigation.
sre-lead: quick brainstorm: (1) increase nf_conntrack_max cluster-wide in node bootstrap, (2) reduce conntrack timeout for ESTABLISHED? or (3) reduce ephemeral socket churn from the model-serving side (longer keepalive), (4) add a scheduler cushioning policy to avoid immediate GPU preempts during transient network noise.
mira: agree. adding node sysctl change is straightforward but risks memory pressure on smaller nodes. we should also reduce conntrack timeout for CLOSE_WAIT -> 30s: ```sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_close_wait=30```
alex: on scheduler side, we could add a small "preempt_cushion" by reserving a fractional GPU capacity per rack (e.g., 5%) so the scheduler won't preempt aggressively during short spikes. config snippet idea: ```--feature-gates=PreemptCushion=true``` (prototype).
jamal: that'd be great for immediate relief. long term we should profile the client workloads — the multipart uploads/open sockets are the likely offender.
sre-lead: action items: 1) mira to prepare cluster-wide sysctl rollout + helm node-init changes (ETA 2h) 2) alex to prototype scheduler cushion flag canary in ap-southeast1-b (ETA 4h) 3) jamal to gather example pcap / connectivity traces and list offending jobs (ETA 1h).
mira: starting PR for node-init change now. will add a gate to only bump on GPU fleets first.
jamal: quick note — cost impact: bumping nf_conntrack_max increases kernel memory per table. estimate ~8MB extra per node at 262k entries; for 400 GPU nodes that's ~3.2GB across fleet. list this for finance/infra runway.
sre-lead: noted. we balance cost vs availability; run canary and monitor mem pressure metric (node_memory_MemAvailable?).
alex: if the preempt cushion works, we can avoid emergency node-level tunings in other regions.
mira: rolling canary begun on 2 nodes in rack-7. will report. :thumbsup:
jamal: thanks all — will post short postmortem if pattern repeats.
